title: The Little Kitten
lines: A little kitten sits on the table.
It bats at a red apple.
The apple rolls off the table.
It bumps a candle and a glass bottle.
The bottle tips and spills on the rug.
The kitten hides in a red mitten.
Meg picks up the apple and the bottle.
She rubs the chin of the little kitten.
The kitten naps in the mitten.

questions.ask: What knocked the candle and the bottle over?
questions.listenFor: The apple, after it rolled off the table. If they say "the kitten," ask them to follow the apple line by line.
In a red mitten. Stated in the story - have them find the line and read it back to you.

questions.ask: Do you think the kitten meant to make a mess? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. You want a reason - "no, it was just batting at the apple" or "yes, cats do that on purpose."
